title: adaptive-idle-coalescer-slice-tuning
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Continuous batchers have a soft window where short-lived (latency-sensitive) requests can be coalesced into larger batches to improve GPU utilization. However, we observed KV-pin storms and cold-KV miss sequences that either cause starvation for long-tail requests or create oscillations in batch sizes. This PR introduces an adaptive, slice-based idle coalescer that dynamically adjusts wait-slices per-queue using lightweight telemetry and a probabilistic backoff to avoid synchronized wavefronts.

Summary of changes: Implements an idle-coalescer module in the batcher scheduler that: 1) splits the existing linger window into N adaptive slices; 2) tracks per-model and per-tenant recent KV-hit ratios and uses a sliding EWMA to bias early-slice admission for KV-hot traffic; 3) applies a small randomized jitter to slice deadlines to break synchronization; 4) exposes two new knobs -- "slice_target_ms" and "slice_decay_factor" -- for ops tuning; 5) adds a probe path that allows a tiny number of requests to bypass coalescing when starvation is detected; 6) surfaces metrics and traces (batch_coalesce.slices, kv_hint_evictions, starvation_probes) for SLO reconciliation. Additionally adds a minor kernel-dispatch alignment hint that groups prefetch-friendly dispatches to reduce KV cache thrash on the hot path.

Why this is different: Instead of one global linger window we use fine-grained slices with explicit fairness quotas per scheduling class. This reduces head-of-line blocking caused by large requests while retaining coalescing benefits for high-throughput models. The probabilistic probe prevents silent starvation without a heavyweight preemption mechanism.

Testing & results: Microbenchmarks (local perf lab) and a 2-hour canary on staging with mixed traffic (chatty short requests + long-context reranks) show: - 18% reduction in p99 latency for short requests under 60% load; - 12% throughput improvement for medium-length generations at 90% GPU occupancy; - kv-hit stabilization (variance reduction) on models with high KV churn. Load tests and canary logs attached in the commits.

Rollout plan: Feature-flag guarded (batcher.enable_adaptive_slices=false by default). Gradual rollout: enable for one tenant group, monitor metrics for 24h, then expand. Ops knobs documented in the console and in the scheduler tuning guide.

Checklist: - [x] design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/adaptive-slice-coalescer-design - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration test in perf-lab harness - [x] telemetry and dashboards wired - [x] feature-flag gating
commits: feat(batcher): add adaptive idle coalescer core loop (initial implementation)
perf(batcher): slice deadline jitter and probabilistic probe path
chore(batcher): expose ops knobs and feature flag
test(batcher): add unit + integration tests for slice semantics
perf(kv): kernel dispatch hint to reduce cache thrash
docs: scheduler tuning notes and rollout steps
review_thread: Diego Alvarez: Design looks solid overall; please justify the choice of EWMA window size in the comment and add a short note on worst-case added latency.
Maya Chen: Responded: increased EWMA alpha from 0.2 to 0.35 after running sensitivity tests. Added comment in code explaining rationale and worst-case bound (~slice_target_ms extra).
Rina Patel: Can we ensure the probe path cannot amplify load during a KV storm? Recommend an absolute cap per-queue.
Maya Chen: Added a per-queue probe cap (configurable ops knob) and unit tests asserting cap enforcement.
Tomás O'Neill: CI flakes on perf-lab harness when kernel hint is enabled; please add a guard to skip the hint on older CUDA drivers.
Maya Chen: Added driver detection and a safe fallback path. Re-ran canary; no regressions observed.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive idle coalescer for continuous batcher: slice-based coalescing, KV-aware admission, starvation probes, ops knobs for tuning. Feature-flag gated.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind batcher.enable_adaptive_slices. Default off. Recommended initial settings: slice_target_ms=6, slice_decay_factor=0.85, probe_cap_per_queue=3. Watch metrics: batch_coalesce.slices, kv_hint_evictions, starvation_probes, batch_size.p50/p99.
backport_plan: Not required; rollout via feature flag. If urgent, backport to release-2026.01 branch with same feature flag defaults.
